name: mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel bshad theg po chen po la 'jug pa (1)
item_description:
See also [AT6DUUJJ]: 20.
Paper: heavy rice paper, in good condition, apart from fol. 1a and a butter stain at the bottom of the first 50 folios.
Black ink, with citations from the Abhisamayālaṃkāravṛtti (ID:3711) in red ink.
Extracts from other sources highlighted in blue ink.
Script: 'bru tsha.
Lines per folio: 8.
Orthographic and paleographic particularities:
- superabundant 'a chung (bde' ba, bzhi', dbye')
- palatalization in myed
- lengthening of the down stroke in letters such as ta, da, etc.
Numerous glosses and corrections by at least two different hands, in dbu med and dbu can, in particular glosses identifying the "kha cig." Some annotations without shad between words.
Illegible two lines - title (?) - in dbu can on cover page, with an annotation in dbu med underneath.
Addition by a different hand (maybe modern) after the colophon: dnyal pa zhig pos mzdad pa || dmyal tig ¦
